item.coloph: enedkeg-un paṇḍita yeke mergen samanta shrī-luγ-a , töbed-un ayaq-γ-a tegimlig čhos rab ner-e-tü kelemürči orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai , ene dandr-a-yi mongγol-un kelen-dür kungga od-zer mergen manǰusrī paṇḍita gusi orčiγulǰu orusiγulbai .

hidkeg-un (!) baṇḍiḓa yeke mergen samanta šri-luγ-a, töbed-un / ayaγ-q-a tegimlig čovas rab neretü kelemeči orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai, ene ṱanḓr-a-yi / mongγol-un kelen-tür küngga ovaḓzêr mergen mañǰušri baṇḓiḓa güsi orčiγulǰu orosiγulbai. , .

……čaγ-un kürdün-ü nigen mingγan γučin toγatan silüg-ün-eče čiγuluγsan abisig-i sayitur üiledküi ner-e-tü tegüsbe, enedkeg-ün bandida yeke mergen samanta siri-luγ-a, töbed-un ayaγ-qa takimlig čui rab ner-e-ṯü kelemeči orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai, ene dandir-a-yi mongγol-un kelen-tür künḍega od zêr mergen mañjusiri bandi da güi si orčiγulǰu orosiγulbai.
